crisp_correction.method: Source-bound joint cutout mapping in Aseprite, preserving fixed body. Source hand/arm drawings replace all generated moving pixels. No temporal blur/blending, global sharpening or additional generated takes.
crisp_correction.codex_frame_inspection: Painted outlines clearer in frame-step; machine-only body/endpoint/round-trip PASS. Intermediate arm lengths, wrist/elbow/source switches and shoulder seam still need owner review.
crisp_correction.limitations: Source-cutout articulation changes bone lengths between different authored poses; it is not a production-approved rig or seamless loop.
crisp_correction.owner_review: Body fixed with only arm redrawn is inadequate; continuity requires figure-wide shoulder, torso, dress/bodice and hair response.
